send.title: Send staff notification
send.noTemplates: No template is available. Ask an administrator to enable one on the Staff notifications page.
send.emailDescPassword: Sign-in email, random password and download buttons. This template must be sent by email
send.emailDesc: Sent to the staff member's sign-in email
send.smsDescPassword: Reminds them to check their email and get the app. No password. Sent only after the email goes out
send.smsDesc: Sent to the Australian mobile number on the staff profile
send.smsServiceOffHint: The SMS master switch is off on the server, so only email can be sent.
send.smsSenderHint: The sender name shown on the recipient's phone
send.noChannelSelected: Turn on at least one channel.

reason.alreadyLoggedInHint: Last sign-in {{when}}; the old password stops working
reason.suspiciousEmailHint: {{domain}} does not look like a real mailbox
reason.loginDisabledHint: Sign-in is restricted for this account; allow sign-in before sending
reason.notFoundHint: The account may have been deleted. Refresh the list
reason.selfHint: You cannot send to yourself: issuing a password would sign you out
reason.noChannelHint: None of the selected channels can reach this person (for example SMS only but no phone)
reason.inProgressHint: This person is already in another batch that is still sending

preview.title: Preview
preview.subject: Subject
preview.passwordNote: The password is generated at send time. Nobody in the admin can see it, and it is not stored in the send log.

confirm.title: Send "{{name}}"?
confirm.emailPassword: {{count}} emails, each with a new random password
confirm.smsValue: {{count}} SMS, about {{cost}} ({{used}} / {{limit}} sent in the last 24 hours)
confirm.smsQuotaExceeded: This would go over the daily SMS limit; the extra messages will fail.
confirm.reissueBody: Once the email goes out, their old passwords stop working and they are signed out on every phone and computer. They must sign in again with the new password in the email.
confirm.reissueCheck: I confirm a new password will be issued to staff who have already signed in
confirm.passwordHint: Random passwords are valid for 72 hours and must be changed at first sign-in. Send again if one expires.

progress.title: Sending "{{name}}"
progress.note: Closing this window does not stop the sending. Check the results in the send log.
progress.closedToast: Sending continues in the background. Check the results in the send log.
progress.pollFailed: Cannot get the progress right now. Sending continues in the background; check the send log later.

result.title: Send result
result.interrupted: Sending was interrupted. The table shows what was recorded; use Retry failed to send what is missing.
